overview.title: Agent-usable FilmCraft (ArtCraft/storytold, MIT or Apache-2.0; a Premiere-style editor in Rust) through its headless CLI: commands, the sequence as a CL Scene, scripted edits, export and frames.

mod.filmcraft.commands.effect: List FilmCraft engine commands (id, label, params) matching a filter.
mod.filmcraft.commands.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

mod.filmcraft.inspect.effect: Observe a project's active sequence as a CL Scene: tracks, clips, in/out, effects, transitions, markers.
mod.filmcraft.inspect.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

mod.filmcraft.run.effect: Run engine commands in order on a project (a new project when omitted) and save it.
mod.filmcraft.run.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

mod.filmcraft.export.effect: Export the active sequence and check the outcome contracts on the file.
mod.filmcraft.export.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

mod.filmcraft.frame.effect: Render one Program frame to PNG.
mod.filmcraft.frame.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

mod.filmcraft.verify.effect: Real round trip: import real Neyvia captures, place clips, export, then the outcome contracts.
mod.filmcraft.verify.pre: Selected workspace; the mod is installed, enabled and its local tool is present

verify-filmcraft.goal: Run the real round trip and check its outcome contracts

pitfalls.recovery: Build or point the NEYVIA_* path at it; the action refuses rather than downloading anything.

pitfalls.failure: A render exists but is wrong
pitfalls.recovery: Read the outcome block (duration, frames, black/frozen runs, clipping); never call a render good from its exit code.

frontier: Built from source with the local Rust toolchain into D:/NeyviaRuns/video/track-video/target; set NEYVIA_FILMCRAFT_CLI to use another build.
Adapted, not forked: every action runs the unmodified upstream program. FilmCraft by the ArtCraft team, MIT OR Apache-2.0, https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft.
guidance: Every FilmCraft menu item is an engine command with typed params; list them with mod.filmcraft.commands and run them with mod.filmcraft.run.
Times are integer ticks (254016000000 per second); most commands also accept seconds=.
Read the sequence back with mod.filmcraft.inspect after every edit; export and read the outcome contracts before claiming a render.
Installs switched off from Marketplace > Apps & mods; read this manual and the declared permissions, then enable it.
